about.title: Redding Product Liability Claims
about.longDescription: A product that fails in Redding does not have to be exotic to cause real harm. It might be a space heater in a Shasta County home during a cold snap, a ladder that buckles on a weekend project, a pressure cooker, or a tire or airbag that does not do its job in a collision on Churn Creek Road or Route 273. Redding logged 401 injury collisions in 2025, and a failed part is sometimes part of that story. California law treats these cases differently from most injury claims. Under strict liability, you generally do not have to prove the manufacturer was careless. You need to show the product had a defect in its design, its manufacturing, or its warnings, and that the defect caused your injury. Responsibility can reach the maker, the distributor, and the store that sold it. LawProactive is a free connection service, not a law firm. We match Redding residents with an independent attorney who takes product cases on contingency.

whyChoose.title: Why Redding Residents Use LawProactive for Product Cases

items.title: Strict Liability Changes the Question
items.desc: In California you usually do not have to show the manufacturer was negligent, only that the product was defective and that the defect hurt you. The attorney we connect you with knows how to frame a design, manufacturing, or warning defect under that standard.

items.title: More Than One Party May Answer
items.desc: The company that made the product, the distributor that moved it, and the Redding retailer that sold it can all share responsibility. Identifying each of them early can matter to how a claim unfolds.

items.title: The Product Is the Evidence
items.desc: Keeping the failed item, its packaging, and any receipts is often the single most important step. An attorney can help arrange proper storage and inspection so nothing is lost or altered.

items.question: I was in a crash near Hilltop Drive and I think my airbag never deployed. Is that a product case?
items.answer: It might be. Redding saw 531 people injured in traffic collisions in 2025, and some of those injuries are worsened by a vehicle component that did not perform as designed. If an airbag, seat belt, or tire failed, a claim against the manufacturer can exist alongside any claim against another driver. Do not have the vehicle repaired or scrapped before an attorney can arrange an inspection.

items.question: The item was bought at a store in Redding but made overseas. Who do I go after?
items.answer: California's strict liability rules generally allow claims against everyone in the chain of distribution, not just the factory. That can include the importer, the distributor, and the local retailer that sold it to you. An attorney can sort out which parties are reachable and worth pursuing.

items.question: Do I have to prove the company knew the product was unsafe?
items.answer: Usually not. Under strict liability, the focus is on whether the product had a defect in its design, manufacturing, or warnings and whether that defect caused your injury. Whether the maker was careless is often a separate issue. Every case depends on its facts, which is why a review by an independent attorney is a sensible first step.
